name: NTS Radio
author: Sam Fortin
description: NTS Radio 1 and 2 in the Omarchy bar: live show metadata, one-click channel switching, and local playback through mpv.

barWidget.description: Live NTS 1 / NTS 2 with now-playing and playback controls

schema.label: Channel
schema.description: The channel the widget starts on. Switching channels in the panel updates this.

schema.label: Show title in bar
schema.description: Whether the current broadcast title is appended to the NTS mark in the bar.

schema.label: Maximum bar text width
schema.description: Width in pixels for the broadcast title in the bar. Use 0 to hide the title entirely.

schema.label: Playback volume
schema.description: Volume of the NTS stream itself, independent of the system volume.

schema.label: Metadata refresh
schema.description: Minutes between now-playing refreshes while the panel is open or a stream is playing. Idle refreshes are much rarer.
